task_input.note: The scheduler validates the predecessor proof. workflow_run_id plus artifact_sha256 deterministically selects the same bounded URL batch on every retry. Each completed URL result, including its domain fingerprints and SHA-256 digest, is persisted immediately in the claimed task's assessment_checkpoint using the durable task queue's append-only Issue snapshot chain under the live task/resource fencing proof; a retry restores completed results and fetches only incomplete or failed URLs. Legacy manual execution continues to use the persisted rotation cursor.

publication_policy.method: After independent artifact verification, upload the three assessment outputs as an immutable Actions artifact only. No repository filesystem write, Contents API write, commit, push, or source activation is permitted.

resource_contract.lock_scope_note: The only shared mutation is the bounded per-URL assessment_checkpoint in GitHub Issue #423, updated through append-only snapshot CAS under the active task lease and both logical resource fences. The three assessment documents are isolated runner-local artifacts; no repository filesystem write or Contents API publication occurs. The exact discovered_sources predecessor digest is read from the verified external artifact root before and after execution.

execution_semantics.idempotency_key: task_id + predecessor workflow_run_id + predecessor artifact_sha256 + URL; completed URL results are immutable within the task checkpoint.
execution_semantics.retry_policy: Resume the same predecessor-bound batch from the durable task-queue checkpoint. Reuse every completed URL result; repeat network reads only for URLs not yet checkpointed or whose prior fetch failed before a result was stored.
execution_semantics.timeout_note: Task input caps each run at 20 URLs, 1 MB per URL and 10 MB aggregate. Each successful URL is checkpointed immediately by a fenced queue CAS. The adapter timeout is 900 seconds; the 3600-second resource lease is renewed by Watchdog reconciliation and covers delayed workflow completion events plus independent artifact verification.
success_predicate: Process exits with code 0 and stdout satisfies the reviewed output schema.
Runner-local assessment history, runtime document and report pass schema and shard-integrity verification.
Protected config and all declared read-only repository baselines remain unchanged.
Per-URL progress is stored in the durable task queue with live task and logical resource fencing; no repository artifact publication occurs.
execution_semantics.independent_verifier: scripts/verify_assess_sources_artifacts.py independently checks runner-local runtime/history/report consistency, fingerprints exclusion and non-activation.
execution_semantics.repository_writes: No repository file writes, commits, or GitHub Contents API writes. Per-URL progress is stored only in GitHub Issue #423 durable queue snapshots through append-only CAS under the active task lease and logical/source-assessment-checkpoints plus logical/production-pipeline fences.

dependency_edges.edge_semantics: The Watchdog workflow_run gate downloads the artifact from the exact successful main-branch Shadowrocket Source Discovery (Watchdog) run, validates producer run ID/head SHA and the logical-document digest, then enqueues Assessment idempotently.
dependency_edges.note: The producer writes only to its isolated RUNNER_TEMP workspace and uploads the complete logical document as an immutable artifact. Watchdog verifies the exact run proof, downloaded artifact digest and embedded producer metadata; no sources/ commit or equality with the main-branch baseline is required.
dependency_edges.input_snapshot_validation: The scheduler hashes the complete legacy/sharded discovered_sources document under the verified external predecessor artifact root before claim and after assessment; it rejects missing or changed artifact content.
dependency_edges.scheduler_enforcement: The Watchdog downloads the artifact using the exact workflow_run ID, verifies workflow name, numeric run ID, full producer commit SHA, allowlisted artifact path and complete logical-document digest, then sets AUTOMATION_PREDECESSOR_ARTIFACT_ROOT to the verified external artifact directory. enqueue_source_assessment_task and scheduler.build_execution_plan independently recheck that exact external artifact digest before claim; the assessor rechecks it before and after execution.

permission_boundary.filesystem: Active independent mode writes assessment documents only beneath AUTOMATION_ARTIFACT_ROOT under RUNNER_TEMP. The only shared mutation is the bounded Issue #423 task checkpoint under the live task lease and both logical resource fences. No repository checkout file is modified.
permission_boundary.network: HTTPS raw.githubusercontent.com only, repository-bound URL and same-host redirect checks.
permission_boundary.github_api: The assessor may only read and CAS-update the current task's bounded checkpoint in the durable Issue #423 queue using the scheduler-supplied token. It performs no Contents API writes, Git commits, or pushes.
permission_boundary.protected_config: modules/uu.conf is immutable and outside this capability's write set.

blockers: The existing durable queue contains two historical successful Assessment tasks for Discovery run 42373818238 (legacy and parser-v2 idempotency keys); the new predecessor-based resolver recognizes both and suppresses further duplicates. A fresh post-merge run is required to prove exactly one Assessment task for a new Discovery run.
Durable per-URL interruption/resume is unit-tested; live multi-run interruption/resume evidence remains pending.
The global transitive writer inventory for unrelated non-dispatchable capabilities, dynamic path aliases and cross-workflow effects remains partial; those capabilities remain deny-by-default.
Production ruleset publication must continue to pass the rulesets/** staged-path fence and independent remote verification; modules/uu.conf must remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

review_context.note: The release manifest pins this contract's current blob; the contract intentionally does not reverse-pin the manifest to avoid a circular hash dependency. This is review provenance only.

dependency_contract.enforcement: The Watchdog reconciles the durable Discovery task correlation and independently verified workflow run evidence, validates the exact immutable artifact, then enqueues at most one Assessment task for that predecessor. Existing Assessment tasks are classified by predecessor.workflow_run_id and legacy idempotency-key prefix; only state=ready may enqueue with canonical key source-assessment:<workflow_run_id>. Already-assessed, pending, invalid-evidence, retry-required, or unresolved-predecessor states suppress replacement Discovery dispatch.

assessment_task_deduplication.rule: Only ready may enqueue Assessment. Every other state suppresses duplicate enqueue and replacement Discovery dispatch; retry-required remains visible for bounded recovery rather than silently creating a new Discovery run.

retry_policy.resume: durable per-URL result checkpoint in GitHub Issue #423 durable queue snapshots (repository bootstrap is read-only), atomically updated with queue Issue snapshot chain under active task/resource fencing
retry_policy.remote_fetches_may_repeat: only for URLs not yet checkpointed or whose previous fetch failed before a result was persisted
retry_policy.repository_writes: per-URL durable queue checkpoint; final verified history/report outputs under live fenced leases
